content.short: Swell is a liquid restaking protocol and L2 on Ethereum providing yield-bearing assets via swETH and rswETH.
content.description:
Swell Network is a leading decentralized restaking ecosystem designed to maximize rewards for Ethereum participants while maintaining capital liquidity. The platform features swETH, a premier liquid staking derivative, and rswETH, a highly composable liquid restaking token that allows users to simultaneously earn Ethereum staking rewards and additional yields from Actively Validated Services (AVS) on EigenLayer and Symbiotic. Swell has also launched its own "restaked rollup" L2 to serve as a primary hub for restaking yields.

Governed by the SWELL token, the protocol features a robust governance model and a sustainable reward framework that incentivizes long-term participation. Swell focuses on providing a secure, non-custodial, and user-friendly environment for both retail and institutional stakers. By leveraging its modular architecture and deep integration with the DeFi ecosystem, Swell Network is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of the restaking economy, empowering users to build more robust and efficient decentralized portfolios with ease.
content.meta: Swell Network provides liquid restaking derivatives and a restaked Layer 2 hub for the Ethereum ecosystem.
